comments.author: throw_nbvc1234
comments.story: Geoffrey Hinton leaves Google and can now speak freely about his AI concern
comments.why: Fiction showing AI continuing attacks after humans are incapacitated.
comments.text: identify a target decide to attack the target implement the attack determine the result of the attack If humans are required for the decision, then humans have an inherent hook to prevent more attacks. Otherwise you run into scenarios like [VIDEO] where humans are incapacitated and AI just continue on like nothing has happened. It makes the failure modes more sane. It's not a catch-all but a good agreeable step to take.
